note: Phase 6 CHANGE TUTORIALS (owner's D2 pick): every major change ships a walkthrough here; the beat nags when a dashboard build has none. Newest first on the cockpit's Direction card.

tutorials.title: M4 SHIPPED — hands, not just a hub: HORSE, packages, the launcher, the hub-endpoint

interactive.try: The new 🧰 Packages tab (M4.3): reusable KITS of real hub elements. Assemble one by naming elements (loose names resolve), 📌 pin the ones you use, ✎ edit, then ▶ Run all (sends the kit to EXCAVA as one task) or ▶ Run each. Pinned kits float to the top.

Hub-as-database (M4.5): Excavatortron publishes a PUBLIC endpoint (refreshed every beat). Copy it — Budoaris / FreeDup / any tool (or the activator offline) can GET it and pull a whole package or a single element, each with its install line + link.

HORSE (M4.2): type a goal here (or /horse <goal>). TEN agents each FULLY execute it on a spread of free engines; the results are scored to your work-taste and the best merged into one deliverable — it appears in 📦 Results, attributed 'HORSE ×10'.
Proof it's real (M4.6): ① the newest artifact the hourly beats built while you were away (unattended), and ② the path from a typed goal to a runnable package. Both live on the cockpit.

steps: HORSE (M4.2): 10 agents each fully execute a goal on varied free engines; results scored against your work-taste (M3.11b) and the best merged into one deliverable. Trigger: console /horse or 'EXCAVA: HORSE <goal>'. Runs on the CI beat; merged artifact lands in Results.

Packages (M4.3): reusable kits in data/packages.json — assemble (loose names → real element ids), pin the frequent, edit, Run-all (kit → one EXCAVA task) / Run-each, Save-to-EXCAVA. Grown by you + room artifacts + brain-graph cluster orders.

Parent launcher (M4.4): launcher/ 'ORBIT' — its OWN calm minimal brand (deliberately not Heavy-Machinery); a project-cube grid; each cube is a full context switch to the project's own app; EXCAVA-made projects auto-appear.

Hub-as-database (M4.5): src/build_hub_api.py publishes docs/hub_api.json (packages fully resolved to element install+url + a compact index of the real elements); refreshed every beat; any project pulls a package via the endpoint or the activator.
M4.1 portable activator is on the Opus track (compressed-hub SKILL.md + live fetch, obeys the triggers, works offline) — Fable shipped M4.2–M4.6.
Prove-real (M4.6): the cockpit shows (a) the newest artifact a beat built unattended, and (b) the goal → runnable-package path — the two acceptance proofs for 'real'.

tutorials.title: M3 SHIPPED — the new look: monsters, the isometric factory, results, taste, mobile

interactive.try: The floor is now an ISOMETRIC factory (M3.3): each department is its own building on a ring around the core, a monster at the door, a roof lamp = its real status. Click a building to ENTER it — a side-view cutaway opens (lead office / agent floor / worker line) with the real named lead and real bus counters.

The animation catalog (M3.4): weld=fix, hammer=build, magnify=test, stamp=verify, party=deliver, dig=research, film=media, carry=hand-off, wave=pitch, sleep=idle, pancake=open. Every prop on the floor is a REAL last-beat event — hover one to see which.
The 11-species monster CAST (M3.2) now fronts every chat bubble — suited leads and agents, each matched to its department. Same faces walk the floor and the cutaways.

The 📦 Results feed (M3.7): everything EXCAVA produced, attributed to who made it, filter by day / department / maker. Open it, send it to a project, or jump to the making-of chat. A 'new' count rides the tab.
The North Star is now a CONSTELLATION (M3.8): the 9 goals orbit the core as distinct stars, size = live score. Click a star to open its goal, score and gap.

The 🎛 Taste panel (M3.11b): two editable profiles — DESIGN taste (learned from Arena votes, tunable) and WORK taste (6 dials that feed HORSE). Drag a slider; it saves instantly. 💾 Save to EXCAVA persists it for the cloud beats.

steps: Monster cast (M3.2): 11 code-drawn species, one per department, each with a suited named lead, an agent, and a small worker — wired into the Rooms bubbles, the floor stations, and the walking bus bots.

Isometric factory floor + cutaways (M3.3): department buildings on a ring around the core; entering a department opens a side-view cutaway with the real staff and live bus counters; a floor clock shows the beat number (M2.7 timing readout).
Animation catalog (M3.4): 11 distinct action props, each spawned from a real bus/beat event — lively but purposeful, never decorative.
Final card visual (M3.6): refined-neobrutalist cards — organic radii, chunky borders, resting hard shadows, brushed grain; the action row appears on hover/focus.
Results feed (M3.7), North-Star constellation (M3.8), brain graph explore-to-package (M3.9): the three ways to see and reuse what EXCAVA makes.
Steering (M3.11): a header bell + count, a dismissible approval banner, a monster that walks up on new approvals, and pitches that open as conversations you approve or decline.
Editable taste (M3.11b) + mobile pass (M3.12): tune design-taste and work-taste by hand; on a phone you read, review, approve and send — execution (run buttons) stays on the desktop/cloud.

tutorials.title: M2 — real agents: named cast, live conversations, artifacts

interactive.try: The beat log now shows rooms advancing: named agents (Echo, Marrow, Ledger, Bastion, Nova…) speak via real free engines each CI beat — watch for 'X spoke (engine, ms)'.
Fleet health now reflects 38 named agents across 11 departments — leads wear suits, checkers push back by design (debate → converge).
Send a task: it becomes a WAR ROOM — doer proposes, checker challenges, lead states 'DECISION:' and a real artifact (package / bus task / labeled creation) is committed.

steps: 38 NAMED agents staff the 11 departments (roster: python -m src.excava_agents --roster): suited leads with personas that match the department AND change behavior; doers; skeptic checkers; improvers.

Conversations are the work mechanism (src/excava_chat.py): dept/cross/group/WAR rooms, real engine calls per message (agent · engine badge is truth), archived by day under data/excava/chats/, replayable.

Engines (M2.1): 9 free families first-class + optional self-hosted Hermes + optional OmniRoute gateway + Claude premium on your Pro (tight daily cap). Lease arbiter (M2.2): per-dept daily budgets, per-engine RPM, zero runaway.
Rooms produce ARTIFACTS on convergence: packages (data/packages.json), bus tasks, or G-12-labeled creations — transcript is proof, artifact is the point.
Self-improvement is real (M2.8): auto-tunes budgets, retires silent rooms, logs to improvements.jsonl — and files a PITCH for anything overhaul-class (P5: only 3 things wait for you).
PROTOCOLS.md (P1-P14) is law: the beat self-audits it every cycle; removing a protocol trips SAFE mode (proven in test).

tutorials.title: M1 — real, verified elements you can actually use

interactive.try: Open the Tools tab — every card now wears a verification badge: ✓ verified (2+ sources + live test), ◆ niche-verified (kept forever), unverified (never shown as real), ✗ dead (hidden).
On any card: ⚡ Activate copies a ready recipe · 🥞/🟢 Open jumps into the code (<10s; green = pre-warmed, instant) · 🦾 Use for a task sends it to EXCAVA · ▶ Video plays the real source.
Click 🔍 Detail on any card: the full element — embedded source-video bundle, related elements (really shown together), enrichment evidence, install line.

Three new 24/7 lanes: hourly discovery (GitHub/HN/ProductHunt/social — new tools land same-day), deep-retrieve (rebuilds thin items from FULL transcripts+READMEs), and the rolling verifier (2-source standard, conflicts noted).

steps: All 6,422 hub items are now ONE element model with verification: ✓ needs 2+ independent sources AND a live link test; below the bar = 'unverified', never shown as real; dead = hidden only after 2 consecutive full failures; niche kept forever (your P3 law).
Every card on Skills/Tools/Models/Prompts/Connectors/Designs has the action row: Activate / Open (<10s, pre-warmed instant) / Use-for-a-task / Video / Source / Detail.
The 🔍 Detail view (#element/<id>) shows the source-video bundle, 3-8 truly-related elements, enrichment evidence and trust.
CORE SPOT-ON lanes run 24/7: hourly discovery agent (same-day new tools), 2-hourly deep-retrieve (stub-rate → 0), 6-hourly verify+relate+prewarm (rolling weekly full pass).

tutorials.title: REHAB WAVE 1 — decide everything IN THE APP: approvals, pitches, the truth chip

interactive.try: Every item waiting on YOU now has a 'Review & decide' button. Click one: plain-language explanation, a review box, Approve/Decline. Pitches carry WHO asks, the NEED with real numbers, HOW important, WHAT'S missing — plus tools EXCAVA found in its own hub.

THE TRUTH CHIP: after you decide, the chip says 'NOT SENT — tap to send' in orange until the cloud really received it. One extra click ('Send to the cloud beat' → Submit) finishes it. If it says 'sent ✓', EXCAVA has it.

steps: Approval queue → Review & decide → read who/need/importance/missing → Approve or Decline with a note
Watch the chip: orange NOT-SENT until you complete the send — no more silent lost reviews

steps: Leave the app open — it updates itself; the dot tells you when
